title: Cosmic Spiral Eye
description: A surreal swirling vortex painting features concentric rings of deep blue, brown, and purple. At the glowing orange center is a geometric orb with a tiny figure standing before it, while symbolic white line art depicts an all-seeing eye with a planet, a crowned sun-like face, and abstract figures throughout the spiral.
prompt: surreal symbolic painting of a cosmic spiral vortex in deep blues, browns and purples, with a glowing orange geometric orb at the center containing a small standing figure, surrounded by white line art of an all-seeing eye holding a planet, a crowned sun face with third eye, abstract human forms and geometric symbols flowing through the swirling composition
